Cosmologist Brian Keating joins Joe Rogan to tell the life and finds of Galileo in a segment from the show. Keating is a space scientist who studies the birth of the cosmos. Galileo is the father of the modern way to read the sky.

Keating tells how Galileo built his scope, saw the moons of Jupiter, and faced the church for his claims. He shares the man's wit, flaws, and grit in the face of the law. Rogan asks what his tale teaches men of science now. Listeners get a bright life in a tight cut. The library holds the segment as an archive record.
